data.name: Kaleel
data.long_meaning: The name Kaleel is of Arabic origin and means 'messenger' or 'speaker'. This name is derived from the Arabic root word 'k-l-l' which means 'to speak' or 'to communicate'. In Islamic history, Kaleel is the name of an angel mentioned in the Quran who is responsible for conveying Allah's messages to the Prophets.

in_arabic.name: كليل
